tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ bka' rdzogs pa chen po padma yongs grol snying thig las: gu ru zhi ba'i zlog pa byad kha 'bum thub bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ de nas be ro tsa nas gser gyi maṇḍal phul nas zhus pa: e ma ho: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las pa: byin rlabs 'gran zla bral ba'i skyabs gcig pu: phrin las zlog pa'i thugs rje deng dgongs la: bdag la gsan cing dus 'dir dgongs su gsol: da lta dus bzang skal bzang bde lags kyang: ma 'ongs sems can bar chad tshe thung zhing: khyad par lha srin sde brgyad kha rgyas nas: sgrub la bar chad sems can yongs la 'tshe: de dus zlog cing zhi bar mdzad slad du: bla ma sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir bstan nas: bar chad zlog pa'i thabs shig bka' stsol cig: zhes zhus pas: slob dpon padma'i zhal nas gsungs pa: e ma de ltar zhu ba shin tu legs: gu ru rdo rje gro lod la bsten nas: zlog pa'i thabs lam zab mo yod kyi nyon: de la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o: sngon 'gro bca' ba'i thabs lam ni: lcags khang nang du gru gsum bya: gru gsum steng du stag ras bting: de steng dmar gtor gru gang bya: dbus su rdo rjes mtshan pa bri: thugs kar phur bus mtshan par bya'o: de yi phyi rim gtor ma lnga: de yi phyi rim brgyad dang bcas: de yi phyi rim dur khrod de: de yi phyi rim sgo mtshams byed: bar bar dpal gtor dgu 'am brgyad: de 'og dur khrod bkod pa bya: ru dra'i zhing lpags gdan du bting: phyi rim rtsang dmar brgya rtsa brgyad: steng du khyung dmar brgyan pa 'o: 'og tu lcags sdig nag po bya: khrag thun yungs thun me chu sogs: rdo thun dug thun khrag thun bsags: las byang gzhung bsrang bskang ba bya: de nas dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni: de nyid ngang las dran rdzogs su: dur khrod 'jigs rung gzhal yas dbus: dgra bgegs nyi ma dmar po'i gdan: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros tshur 'dus pas: thod phreng rdo rje gro lod sku: gtum drag rngams shing 'jigs pa'i zhal: dbu skra smug 'bol g.yas su 'khyil:

sku la me yi na bza' gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs: g.yon pas 'khar ba'i phur bu 'dril: spyi gtsug rta skad phyogs bcur 'tsher: mgrin par yungs thun skar ltar 'phro: thugs kar rdo rje glog ltar 'khyug: lte bar phur thun ser ltar 'phro: gsang gnas dug thun khrag ltar khol: stag mo'i steng na 'gying stabs bzhugs: gnas 'dir bla ma gshegs su gsol: mi sha khrag gi mchod yon bzhes: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod yon bzhes: ba liṃ rgyan gyi mchod pa bzhes: dpal chen rdo rje gro lod khyed: mkha' 'gro ma yis mtshan gsol ba: smug nag gtum po gshegs su gsol: phyi nang bar chad zlog tu gsol: dpal chen rdo rje gro lod khyed: mkha' 'gro ma yis mtshan gsol ba: 'jigs byed rdo rje gshegs su gsol: phyi nang bar chad zlog= dpal chen rdo rje gro lod khyed: mkha' 'gro ma yis mtshan gsol ba: sgrol byed rnal 'byor gshegs su gsol: phyi nang bar chad zlog= dpal chen rdo rje gro lod khyed: mkha' 'gro ma yis mtshan gsol ba: dbang phyug gro lod gshegs su gsol: phyi nang bar chad zlog= dpal chen rdo rje gro lod khyed: mkha' 'gro ma yis mtshan gsol ba: gter gyi dbang phyug gshegs su gsol: phyi nang bar chad zlog= dpal chen rdo rje gro lod khyed: mkha' 'gro ma yis mtshan gsol ba: bde gshegs 'dus pa gshegs su gsol: phyi nang bar chad zlog= dpal chen rdo rje gro lod khyed: mkha' 'gro ma yis mtshan gsol ba: rdo rje gtum drag gshegs su gsol: phyi nang bar chad zlog tu gsol: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug spyan gsum bgrad: lha yi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: las kyi dbang phyug mche dkar gtsigs: gshin rje'i dmod pa zlog tu gsol: drag sngags dbang phyug ljags dmar 'dril: lha min dmod pa zlog= ma mo'i dbang phyug ral pa 'khyil: ma mo yongs kyi ltas ngan zlog: gsung gi dbang phyug rta skad sgrog:

nang bdud gsung gi bar chad zlog: las byed dbang phyug yungs dkar 'phro: phyi bdud sku yi bar chad zlog: mthu stobs dbang phyug rdo rje 'phro: gsang bdud thugs kyi bar chad zlog: sreg byed me yi na bza' 'bar: ging btsan yongs kyi bar chad zlog: phrin las phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams: gza' rnams yongs kyi bar chad zlog: phyag g.yon phur bu zur du gsor: mu stegs yongs kyi bar chad zlog: yan lag bzhi la mig bzhi bgrad: mgon po yongs kyi bar chad zlog: gsang gnas dmar nag gyen du sgreng: dbang phyug yongs kyi bar chad zlog: zhabs gnyis 'gying ba'i stabs su bzhugs: gnod sbyin yongs kyi bar chad zlog: stag la spu ris mi gcig grub: bon gyi dzo zor ngan pa zlog: spyan mig dmar nag gyen du zlog: gnam sman yongs kyi bar chad zlog: zhal gdangs ljags dmar bar snang khengs: ru dra ma sang yongs kyi bar chad zlog: zhabs bzhi nyi zla'i gdan la 'dor ba ni: sde brgyad yongs kyi bar chad myur du zlog: hūm̐: gtum drag 'bar ba rdo rje gro lod khyed: phyi yi bar chad phyi ru zlog tu gsol: nang gi bar chad nang du zlog= gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su zlog= ye shes lha yi bka' chad zlog= chos skyong rnams kyi 'khu ldog zlog= yul lha rnams kyi ru nga zlog= sde brgyad yongs kyi gdug rtsub zlog= mtha' yi dmag dpung g.yul 'khrug zlog= dngos grub bar du gcod pa rnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs steng du sgyur: zlogs shig gtum drag gro lod rtsal: sgyur cig ma srin mthu ma chung: zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: 'og gi sngags sogs kyis zlog par bya'o: gnyis pa thod phreng sde lnga la zlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: lha yi bdud kyi bar chad zlog tu gsol: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ratna thod phreng rtsal: 'chi bdag bdud dpung bar chad zlog= dbang gi las mdzad padma thod phreng rtsal:

phung po'i bdud kyi bar chad zlog= drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: nyon mongs bdud kyi bar chad zlog= thams cad lhun grub buddha thod phreng rtsal: dug lnga'i bar chad ma lus zlog tu gsol: kye: rgyal ba'i sras mchog thod phreng sde lnga rnams: 'dir gshegs mi sha khrag gi mchod pa bzhes: dam rdzas bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa bzhes: 'bru sna ba liṃ rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes: phyi yi bar chad phyi ru zlog tu gsol: nang gi bar chad nang du zlog= gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su zlog= ye shes lha yi bka' chad zlog= chos skyong rnams kyi 'khu ldog zlog= yul lha rnams kyi ru nga zlog= sde brgyad yongs kyi gdug rtsub zlog= mtha' yi dmag dpung g.yul 'khrug zlog= dngos grub bar du gcod pa rnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs steng du sgyur: zlogs shig thod phreng sde lnga'i tshogs: sgyur cig ma sring mthu ma chung: zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: gsum pa gu ru mtshan brgyad la phrin las bcol ba ni: hrī: mchog gi bdag nyid padma 'byung gnas pa: lus kyi bar chad ma lus zlog tu gsol: shes bya'i bdag nyid padma saṃ bha ba: ngag gi bar chad ma lus zlog= yon tan bdag nyid padma blo ldan mchog: gang bsam bar chad ma lus zlog= phrin las ngo bo padma seng ge'i sgra: las bsgrub bar chad ma lus zlog= sku yi snang ba padma thod phreng rtsal: brtul shugs drag po'i bar chad zlog= thugs rje'i bdag nyid padma rgyal po'i sku: bsod nams bar chad ma lus zlog= mi nub tshe bdag padma nyi ma'i zer: tshe yi bar chad ma lus zlog= byin rlabs bdag nyid padma shākya seng: dpal 'byor bar chad ma lus zlog= mthu stobs bdag nyid padma gro lod rtsal: dus min nad gdon bar chad zlog tu gsol: kye: bla ma mtshan brgyad sngon gyi thugs dam can: gnas 'dir gshegs la bcol pa'i las kun sgrubs: mi sha khrag gi mchod yon 'di bzhes shig:

dam rdzas bdud rtsi chang gi mchod yon bzhes: sha khrag dmar gyi ba liṃ gtor ma bzhes: phyi yi bar chad phyi ru zlog tu gsol: nang gi bar chad nang du zlog= gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su zlog= ye shes lha yi bka' chad zlog= chos skyong rnams kyi 'khu ldog zlog= yul lha rnams kyi ru nga zlog= sde brgyad yongs kyi gdug rtsub zlog= mtha' yi dmag dpung g.yul 'khrug zlog= dngos grub bar du gcod pa rnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs steng du sgyur: zlogs shig bla ma rig rtsal brgyad: sgyur cig ma sring mthu ma chung: zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: yi dam bka' brgyad la bskul ba ni: hūm̐: che mchog rol pa yon tan lha tshogs rnams: ye shes lha yi bar chad zlog tu gsol: yang dag rol pa thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams: zhi khro yongs kyi bar chad zlog= gshin rje rol pa sku yi lha tshogs rnams: gshin rje yongs kyi bar chad zlog= padma rol pa dbang gi lha tshogs rnams: zil gnon yongs kyi bar chad zlog= phur pa rol pa phrin las lha tshogs rnams: khro bcu yongs kyi bar chad zlog= ma mo rol pa rbod gtong lha tshogs rnams: ma mo yongs kyi bar chad zlog= rig 'dzin rol pa bla ma'i lha tshogs rnams: mkha' 'gro yongs kyi bar chad zlog= dregs pa rol pa 'jig rten lha tshogs rnams: dregs dpon yongs kyi bar chad zlog= drag sngags rol pa dmod pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sngags bdag yongs kyi bar chad zlog tu gsol: kye: sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams: 'dir gshegs bcol pa'i las kun grub par mdzod: mi sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig: dam rdzas bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa bzhes: 'bru sna ba liṃ rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes: phyi yi bar chad phyi ru zlog tu gsol: nang gi bar chad nang du zlog= gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su zlog= ye shes lha yi bka' chad zlog= chos skyong rnams kyi 'khu ldog zlog=

yul lha rnams kyi ru nga zlog= sde brgyad yongs kyi gdug rtsub zlog= mtha' yi dmag dpung g.yul 'khrug zlog= dngos grub bar du gcod pa rnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs steng du sgyur: zlogs shig bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams: sgyur cig ma sring mthu ma chung: zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: de nas dpa' bo ging tshogs la phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: shar phyogs rdo rje ging chen dpa' bo'i tshogs: rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpa' mo rol pa bcas: shar phyogs byad kha 'bum gyi bar chad zlog: lho phyogs rin chen ging chen dpa' bo'i tshogs: rin chen mkha' 'gro dpa' mo rol pa'i tshogs: lho phyogs byad kha 'bum gyi bar chad zlog: nub phyogs padma ging chen dpa' bo'i tshogs: padma mkha' 'gro dpa' mo rol pa'i tshogs: nub phyogs byad kha 'bum gyi bar chad zlog: byang phyogs las kyi ging chen dpa' bo'i tshogs: las kyi mkha' 'gro dpa' mo rol pa'i tshogs: byang phyogs byad kha 'bum gyi bar chad zlog: shar lho sna tshogs dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: shar lho phyogs kyi byad kha 'bum bcas zlog: lho nub dam tshig dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: lho nub phyogs kyi byad kha 'bum bcas zlog: nub byang las kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: nub byang phyogs kyi byad kha 'bum bcas zlog: byang shar drag shul dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: byang shar phyogs kyi byad kha 'bum bcas zlog: zlog sgyur phrin las mdzod cig drag rtsal can: kye: dpa' bo dpa' mo dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs mi sha khrag gi mchod pa bzhes: dam rdzas bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa bzhes: sha khrag dmar gyi ba ling gtor ma bzhes: phyi yi bar chad phyi ru zlog tu gsol: nang gi bar chad nang du zlog= gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su zlog= ye shes lha yi bka' chad zlog= chos skyong rnams kyi 'khu ldog zlog= yul lha rnams kyi ru nga zlog= sde brgyad yongs kyi gdug rtsub zlog=

mtha' yi dmag dpung g.yul 'khrug zlog= dngos grub bar du gcod pa rnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs steng du sgyur: zlogs shig dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: sgyur cig ma sring mthu ma chung: zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: de nas sgo mtshams mar bcol ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: lcags kyu dkar mos shar phyogs bar chad zlog: dri za la sogs gnod pa zlog tu gsol: zhags pa ser mos lho phyogs bar chad zlog: gshin rje la sogs gnod pa zlog= lcags sgrog dmar mos nub kyi bar chad zlog: klu dbang la sogs gnod pa zlog= dril bu ljang mos byang gi bar chad zlog: gnod sbyin la sogs gnod pa zlog= lha mo brtan byed shar lho'i bar chad zlog: me lha la sogs gnod pa zlog= ma mo pho nyas lho nub bar chad zlog: srin po la sogs gnod pa zlog= srin mo 'joms byed nub byang bar chad zlog: rlung lha la sogs gnod pa zlog= gnod sbyin mche gdong byang shar bar chad zlog: bhi na ya sogs bgegs kyi bar chad zlog: kye: slob dpon padma'i phyi 'khor skyong mdzad pa: ma srin dam can rgya mtsho 'dir gshegs shig: mi sha khrag gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dam rdzas bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: sha khrag dmar gyi ba ling mchod pa 'bul: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: phyi nang bar chad ma lus zlog tu gsol: zhes khyung zlog kyang bya: thun dang zor ni kha bskang ltar du bya: sngags bon phur thogs brgya yis glags mi rnyed: sngags nag stong dang 'gras kyang byad mi rnyed: dus min 'chi ba'i tshogs ni zlog par 'gyur: gsol ba gang btab 'grub par gdon mi za: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ma 'ongs sems can don du dag par bris: las 'phro stag sham can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: : ag+th-i: rgya rgya rgya: pho brang shar mdzod shel phug nas// gu ru padma'i thugs rje'i 'od zer las// legs shar rig 'dzin stag sham gling pas bton// yi ge'i ris byed phyogs bral ldom bu ba// kun bzang bde chen snying po zhes pas bgyis// phyi nang gsang gsum bar chad zhi gyur cig// /
